arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2020-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated from 1 October 2019 through 31 January 2020. The data ends on 31 October 2019, so this covers only October.
assumptions: The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 only. The requested period runs to 2020-01-31, so the count covers only 2019-10-01 to 2019-10-31, the part of the period that exists.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
